Summary of websites posted in the 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com — Reports on the latest job report, noting a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a rustic atmosphere, and guests enjoy panoramic city views through large windows. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire complete the experience.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, simple starting point, but it currently only shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself — like your interests, a short bio, or some projects you've worked on — to make it more engaging for visitors. Also, you might want to keep just one contact email to avoid confusion. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's great that you share your love of hiking! The site is quite minimal right now — I'd suggest adding some posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, or tips for fellow hikers to make it more engaging and give visitors a reason to come back. Looking forward to seeing it grow!
